description.description: Package's description from its official webpage, or from its source code webpage

name.description: Package's name used by pacman or yay during installation

repository.description: Repository type from the arch repository website

repository_url.description: Package's URL from the arch repository website; null if there is none

source_url.description: Package's official source code URL; null if there is none

url.description: Package's official webpage URL; null if there is none
